column5: A. Functional Suitability [1. Functional Completeness: The system provides a complete set of functions covering the whole process: registration, company profile and vacancy posting (employer), profile encoding and job recommendations (jobseeker), referral generation, and admin moderation.]
column6: A. Functional Suitability [2. Functional Correctness: The system produces accurate results, such as job recommendations that fit the jobseeker profile and referral slips that show the correct jobseeker, job, and employer.]
column7: A. Functional Suitability [3. Functional Appropriateness: The system functions appropriately support matching a jobseeker to a suitable vacancy and generating a referral.]
column8: B. Performance Efficiency [4. Time Behaviour: The system responds quickly to actions such as submitting forms, generating recommendations, searching, and loading the dashboard.]
column9: B. Performance Efficiency [5. Resource Utilization: The system uses memory, storage, and processing resources efficiently, as observed through developer tools or server monitoring during use.]
column10: B. Performance Efficiency [6. Capacity: The system processes the available set of records (jobseekers, employers, and vacancies) without noticeable slowdown.]
column11: C. Compatibility [7. Co-existence: The system runs in a web browser without negatively affecting other applications on the same device.]
column12: C. Compatibility [8. Interoperability: The system behaves consistently across common web browsers and devices (for example Chrome and Edge, desktop and mobile).]
column13: D. Interaction Capability [9. Appropriateness Recognizability: Users can easily recognize the system purpose and capabilities on first visit, such as from the landing page.]
column14: D. Interaction Capability [10. Learnability: First-time users can easily learn to register, encode a profile, and generate a referral.]
column15: D. Interaction Capability [11. Operability: The system functions (forms, menus, buttons) are easy to operate and control.]
column16: D. Interaction Capability [12. User Error Protection: The system notifies users when invalid data is entered while managing applicant profiles and job vacancies.]
column17: D. Interaction Capability [13. User Engagement: The system interface is inviting and encourages continued use.]
column18: D. Interaction Capability [14. Inclusivity: The system can be used effectively by people of varied technical backgrounds and abilities.]
column19: D. Interaction Capability [15. User Assistance: The system guides users through tasks with on-screen help such as field hints, placeholders, and instructional messages.]
column20: D. Interaction Capability [16. Self-descriptiveness: The system presents information clearly through labels and icons, so its use is obvious without excessive help.]
column21: E. Reliability [17. Faultlessness: The system consistently generates accurate job recommendations and manages records without errors under expected operating conditions.]
column22: E. Reliability [18. Availability: The system is available and accessible whenever needed through its URL.]
column23: E. Reliability [19. Fault Tolerance: The system continues to function properly even when it encounters invalid data entries or minor technical errors.]
column24: E. Reliability [20. Recoverability: After an interruption or restart, the system recovers and previously saved data (profiles, vacancies, referrals) remains intact.]
column25: F. Security [21. Confidentiality: Data is accessible only to authorized users (a jobseeker cannot view another user referral or records).]
column26: F. Security [22. Integrity: The system protects records from unauthorized modification or deletion (only the owning employer can edit their vacancy, only admin can approve employers).]
column27: F. Security [23. Non-repudiation: The system records that key actions occurred (referral timestamps and login records), so they cannot be denied later.]
column28: F. Security [24. Accountability: The system traces actions to the responsible account, for example through the admin login history.]
column29: F. Security [25. Authenticity: The system verifies identity through login before granting access (a wrong password or a deactivated account is denied).]
column30: F. Security [26. Resistance: The system stays secure under unauthorized access attempts (protected pages redirect to login, approval cannot be bypassed by URL).]
column31: G. Maintainability [27. Modularity: The system is organized into independent modules (routes, templates, ML pipeline, database layer) so a change in one does not break others.]
column32: G. Maintainability [28. Reusability: The system reuses shared components such as base templates and helper functions across features.]
column33: G. Maintainability [29. Analysability: The system code and structure make it easy to locate the cause of a defect or the impact of a change.]
column34: G. Maintainability [30. Modifiability: The system can be updated or enhanced to accommodate changes in PESO operational requirements without errors.]
column35: G. Maintainability [31. Testability: The system functions are structured so they can be tested to verify requirements.]
column36: H. Flexibility [32. Adaptability: The system runs across different environments and devices (local and hosted, desktop and responsive mobile).]
column37: H. Flexibility [33. Scalability: The system design (database and architecture) can accommodate a growing number of users and records without significant performance loss.]
column38: H. Flexibility [34. Installability: The system can be deployed and accessed successfully, as shown by its running hosted instance.]
column39: H. Flexibility [35. Replaceability: Records or components can be updated or replaced with minimal disruption (for example editing a vacancy or updating a profile).]
column40: I. Safety [36. Operational Constraint: The system constrains operations within safe rules (it cannot approve an employer with an incomplete profile, and a jobseeker cannot hold two active referrals).]
column41: I. Safety [37. Risk Identification: The system identifies risky or invalid operations before they take effect (for example an invalid salary or age range, or a past deadline).]
column42: I. Safety [38. Fail Safe: The system reverts to a safe state on error and keeps data intact (an invalid form submission returns to the form without data loss).]
column43: I. Safety [39. Hazard Warning: The system gives timely warnings about potential problems (for example reminding the user to complete the profile before applying, or flagging missing required fields).]
column44: I. Safety [40. Safe Integration: The system keeps data consistent across its modules (a referral correctly links the jobseeker, vacancy, and employer, and withdrawal updates access consistently).]
